newsitem.title: UK: Russian seaborne gas oil exports rise in March-Petrak.
newsitem.headline: Russian seaborne gas oil exports rise in March-Petrak.

text.p: Seaborne exports of Russian gas oil from the Black Sea ports of Novorossiisk, Tuapse and Odessa and the Baltic port of Ventspils rose by a touch over 36 percent in March, shipping inspectors Petrak said on Friday.
Gas oil exports from the four ports totalled 1.962 million tonnes in March compared with 1.437 million tonnes in February.
Exports from the Black Sea port of Tuapse fell from 414,000 tonnes to 318,000 tonnes, but rose from the three other ports.
Odessa saw a very strong increase of 407,000 tonnes in March compared with zero in February, while increases at Novorossiisk were more modest at 147,000 against 145,500 in February, Petrak said.
Exports out of Ventspils, the major export outlet in the north, rose to 1,090 million tonnes from 878,000 tonnes in February.
